first_step_test: One small horizontal folded body fixes the scale and the two attachment tips while leaving open paper for both wings, neck, and tail.

source.notes: Six-cell cumulative graphite contact sheet; review before crop.

final_elements.name: folded body
final_elements.description: Draw a small horizontal kite-shaped folded body at page center, with a pointed left and right end.

final_elements.name: near wing
final_elements.description: From the upper-left edge of the body, lift a broad triangular wing upward and outward, returning its lower edge to the body center.

final_elements.name: far wing
final_elements.description: Behind the first wing, lift a slimmer triangular far wing toward the upper right, meeting the same body seam.

final_elements.name: neck and head
final_elements.description: From the right body tip, angle a slender neck upward and bend its tip down into a short pointed beak.

final_elements.name: tail and fold seams
final_elements.description: From the left body tip, raise a narrow pointed tail. Follow the faint fold route within each wing, then rub a small graphite shadow below the body.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains one small horizontal four-point folded-paper body with a center seam; its fixed side tips leave space for the neck and tail and its top leaves open paper for both wings.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I inspected all six saved crops in order and compared each adjacent pair. The horizontal diamond body keeps its anchors; the near and far wings rise separately; the neck and beak join the right tip; the tail joins the left tip before final shading. Faint fold routes persist as paper creases, with no temporary guides or unexplained lost contours.

transitions.observed_addition: The fixed diamond body and its left, right, top and lower points remain; one tall near wing rises from the upper-left body edge and returns to the center seam.
transitions.instruction_match: This is the broad triangular wing described in step two; no existing body edge disappears.

transitions.observed_addition: The body and near wing retain their anchors; a narrower far wing rises behind the center seam to an upper-right point.
transitions.instruction_match: The second wing matches step three and stays behind the near wing.

transitions.observed_addition: The two wing tips and diamond body remain; a slender right neck rises from the right body tip and bends into a pointed beak.
transitions.instruction_match: The neck and beak are the only new structure requested in step four.

transitions.observed_addition: The fixed wings, neck, beak and body remain; a slim left tail extends upward and a soft ground shadow appears below. Faint wing crease routes become easier to read.
transitions.instruction_match: The tail, crease emphasis and shadow match the fifth instruction; the shadow is below the existing body.

transitions.observed_addition: The same two wings, right neck and beak, left tail, body diamond and shadow remain; graphite fills the established wing planes and strengthens the same shadow.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction is shading only; no new contour is introduced.
